name: MTAC 308 175 (MTAC, 175 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, printed ".515". No method mark: method not stated. Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 3, MTAC - Match, Tactical: Caliber .308, Grains 175, Minimum Required Twist *1-10", Part Number MTAC 308 175, G1 BC .515, OAL 1.415", Bullet Projection .785"

note: The twist is marked "*"; page footnote: "*If shooting through transonic, a twist rate increase of 1 inch is recommended (ex: 1:9" instead of 1:10")". Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: .785".
